items.check: Each text surface uses the MD3 role for its purpose (get_type_role). Dialogs, banners, snackbars, onboarding and prose use real reading sizes: Body Medium 14sp, Label Large 14sp for buttons, Title Small or Medium 14 to 16sp. Dense data tokens are only for ticker and price grids.
Nothing is below Label Small (11sp, 0.6875rem).
Colors come from --md-* roles, never hex in component CSS, so light and dark both work.
Sizes are rem or --sp-* / --shape-* tokens. Only hairline borders and shadow offsets are px.
No CSS in markup: no <style> blocks and no static inline style. A dynamic binding that sets a custom property is fine.

Expressive choices were made, not just valid MD3: filled tonal fields, tonal surfaces instead of shadows, the larger end of the shape scale, shape morph on press or selection, spring motion for spatial change.
No more than three radii on one screen. At most one filled primary button and one FAB per screen.
Existing kit components were reused before any new markup was written (list_components).
Component specs respected: top app bar 64 or 112dp, navigation bar 80dp with a 64x32dp indicator, buttons 40dp, chips 32dp, FAB 56dp, icon button 48dp target.
Hover 8%, focus and pressed 10% state layers via color-mix. Disabled is 38% content and 12% container.
Every control has a name. An icon or emoji is not a name: aria-label on the control, aria-hidden on the glyph.

A visual selected state has a programmatic twin: aria-pressed on every button of a toggle group (aria-current for navigation, aria-selected for tabs), updated wherever JS toggles the class, including timers.
A control that opens a dialog has aria-haspopup="dialog" (not aria-pressed). Dialogs are named with aria-labelledby.
One h1, contiguous heading levels, section titles are real headings (reset the margin in CSS instead of using a span).
Text contrast 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text), UI parts 3:1. Meaning is never carried by color alone.
Visible focus ring on :focus-visible, never removed without a replacement. Touch targets at least 48dp.
Spatial motion uses spatial springs, color and opacity use effects springs. prefers-reduced-motion is honored. No transition: all.
Checked at compact (under 40rem), medium and expanded widths. Navigation: bar, rail, drawer. Any change to size or position is checked on a phone, not only inside breakpoint blocks.
Tables are real <table> with header cells, a caption and a unit/date note so people, screen readers and AI extractors read the same thing.
lint_markup returns zero errors on the final markup and CSS.
